# A06 independent review — 2026-09-15

Reviewer: `review_a06_a07`. Verdict: **pass for reviewed code and persisted tests**. Full live
deployment, browser and visual acceptance remain coordinator-owned; this report does not claim them.

Reviewed the A06 repair against the owning [sequential history contract](../../table-spec.md#undo-permissions-and-proposed-campaign-control),
[inline corrections](../../table-spec.md#director-edits-to-inline-results),
[archive boundary](../../table-spec.md#formal-encounter-closeout), and separate character progression.
Checked Q-A-600 and Q-A-601 against their existing answers; neither needs another ruling.

- The current branch, not merely event disposition, controls undo/redo/correction availability.
  Take turn remains outside player undo/redo; Director rewind stays sequential. Player corrections
  obey the campaign undo switch. Director corrections remain distinct seams; player corrections
  retain the recorded character actor. A fully undone intervening action is absent from the effective
  branch; no new permanent same-controller seam was invented.
- Admission/review, targeting preparation and blocked abilities are excluded from gameplay units.
  Undo clears the invoking user's pending targeting. Tests reread actual hero state, build revision,
  draft records, events and dice rather than only checking command descriptions.
- Journal restoration includes whole-record recreation, alias chains and a final reference repair
  after all IDs exist. Repeated foe removal/rewind/redo and subsequent original-result correction
  pass with unchanged recorded dice. No rule evaluator or dice call occurs during restoration.
- History targets, refusal labels and embedded undo/redo descriptions use current audience rules.
  Stored originals remain complete. Cross-campaign history targets are rejected by projection.
- Review identified silent truncation risks in session history and journal/alias reads. Coordinator
  removed those partial reads; full indexed reads now either produce the complete branch or fail at
  backend limits. Result-list correction controls share one loaded history scope. Very large histories
  still require future storage/performance work; no load-capacity claim is made here.

Rules integration: independently reread pinned
[Catch Breath](../../../vendor/steel-compendium/en/unified/md/feature/common/maneuvers/catch-breath.md)
and [Recoveries](../../../vendor/steel-compendium/en/unified/md/rule/health/recoveries.md).
Delegating combat `/hero recover` to canonical `ability.use` preserves the one-Recovery spend,
recovery-value arithmetic and maneuver record; the persisted regression proves retry once and
undo restoring both pools and action usage. Existing R04 cap and current product warning policy
apply. This introduces no new rules interpretation.

Validation: focused A06/A07 history and audience suites passed (see A07 review for the combined
command), including the repaired alias regression. Focused ESLint passed. No remaining blocking
finding within this review's scope.
